spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (नदति नादयति)
1 To speak or emit sound.
2 To shine: see खद.
With वि and अनु,
To fill with noise or sound;
(दु इ,) दुनदि r. 1st cl. (नन्दति)
1 To thrive, to be prosperous.
(Usually with आङ् prefixed,)
To be happy, to be pleased or delighted.
With अभि prefixed,
1 To wish for.
2 To acknowledge or confess.
With प्रति,
To be thankful.

m. (-दः)
A river, applied only to one of which the personification is male, as the Brahmaputra, Śoṇa, Indus, &c.
f. (-दी)
A river in general; the common personification of rivers being female.
E.
नद to sound, affix अट्, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-दः)
1 Sound in general.
2 A semicircle, used especially as an abbreviation or hieroglyphic^1 in mystical works.
E.
नद to sound, affix घञ्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
Sounding, making a sound.
E.
नद to sound, शतृ aff.

m. (-तिः)
The sea.
E.
नद, and नदी, and पति lord.

m. (-नुः)
1 A cloud.
2 A lion.
E.
नद to sound, अनुङ् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्तः)
1 The ocean.
2 A sort of tree, (Barringtonia acutangula): see इज्जल.
3 A small tree, (Vitex negundo.)
f. (-न्ता)
1 A creeper.
2 The rose apple, (Eugenia jambu.)
3 A shrub, (Leea hirta.)
E.
नदी a river, कान्त loved.

n. (-लः)
The bank or shore of a river.
E.
नदी a river, कूल a bank.

m. (-यः)
A sort of reed, (Calamus rotang.)
E.
नदीकूल a river bank, and प्रिय fond of; growing on the banks of rivers.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Aquatic, water-born.
n. (-जं)
1

Antimony.
2

A lotus.
m. (-जः)
1 A sort of tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
2 The marshy date tree.
3 A name of BHĪṢMA.
E.
नदी a river, and ज born.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
One who knows the course of rivers, &c.
E.
नदी, and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-नं)
A Ghāt, a landing place, a ferry.
E.
नदी a river, तर crossing, and स्थान place; also नदीतरस्थल.

n. (-रं)
The bank of a river.
E.
नदी, and तीर a bank.

m. (-नः)
1 The ocean.
2 The god of water, VARUṆA.
E.
नदी a river, and इन lord.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Watered by rivers, (land, rice, &c.)
E.
नदी a river, मातृ a mother, कन् aff.

m. (-यः)
The stream or current of a river.
E.
नदी, and रय going.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The bend or arm of a river.
E.
नदी a river, and वङ्क a bend.

m. (-गः)
The stream or current of a river.
E.
नदी, and वेग speed.

f. (-ला)
The current or stream of a river.
E.
नदी, and वेला flow.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
1 Bathing, &c. in a river.
2 One who knows rivers, their depth, course, &c.
E.
नदी river, स्ना to bathe, ड affix; and स्न changed to ष्ण.

m. (-र्ज्जः)
A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
E.
नदी a river, and सर्ज्ज the Śāl tree.

f. (-यी)
A plant, (Premna herbacea, Rox.)
E.
नदी a river, ढक्, affix; also नादेयी.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Bound, tied.
2 Drawn up, raised.
E.
नह to tye, affix क्त.

f. (-द्धी)
A leather cord, a thong.
E.
नह to bind, ष्ट्रन् aff.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Who or what sounds.
E.
नद to sound, घिणुन् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Ocean or river-born, marine, aquatick.
n. (-यं)
1 Sea salt.
2 Antimony.
f. (-यी)
1 A sort of reed growing usually near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.)
2 A plant, (Premna herbacea, Rox.)
3 The orange.
4 A tree: see जयन्ती.
5 The China rose.
E.
नद a river or the sea, and ढक् affix, fem. affix ङीप्; also with कन् added, in the fem. form नादेयिका f. (-का)
